subject.title: Inglewood — Measure BB (Eliminate Advertising on Public Right-Of-Way)

strong: Ordinance To Eliminate Advertising on Public Right-Of-Way.

text: Shall the ordinance to amend the General Plan and Inglewood Municipal Code to eliminate the City's authority to allow advertising on the public right-of-way and certain available properties, resulting in a loss of general fund revenues, be approved?
SoFi Stadium; Kia Forum; Intuit Dome; Former State Senator Steven Bradford; Pastor KW Tulloss; Edna Cabrera; Charles Braggs
